ev.q: The four who had procedures on the same day had viral sequences with 99%--100% genetic similarity at HVR1
One of the procedures was performed in July 2007; the other five were performed on the same day in September 2007.
The six persons ranged in age from 37 to 72 years; four were female.
Four of the six persons required hospitalization as a result of their HCV infection.

The viral sequence from the HCV-infected person who had the procedure in July 2007 was not genetically related to the other cluster
A joint investigation by SNHD, NSHD, and CDC was initiated on January 9, 2008.

methods_quotes.q: Blood samples were sent to CDC for testing for HCV genotype at the NS5b region and phylogenetic relatedness at the hypervariable 1 region (HVR1)
Case-finding activities included SNHD's review of acute hepatitis C surveillance records
Specimens also were tested for other bloodborne infections (hepatitis B virus [HBV]) and human immunodeficiency virus [HIV])
